coordinateSystem: Pixels in the upright full-resolution JPEG conversion; rect = [left, top, right, bottom].
method: Fourteen complete spreads were visually inspected to choose fold bounds individually. Single-page photographs and covers remain full photographs.

IMG_0904.note: Deterministic crop of the upright JPEG conversion. A small overlap around the inspected fold preserves edge writing and can include part of the neighbouring page. No text, colour, contrast or perspective was altered. Compare the full photograph for page context.
